topActions.title: Make /financial-advisors the target page for "financial advisors": exact phrase in its title and H1, linked from the 41 /financial-advisors URLs

topActions.title: Build a page that targets "credit union"
topActions.why: nerdwallet.com is not in the 10 results Bing (headless Chromium) returned; #1 is lafcu.org/. The phrase appears in 34 of the site's titles/H1s/slugs.

topActions.title: Review whether blocking Google-Extended is intended
topActions.why: Blocks AI training crawlers: Google-Extended. Search-time bots are allowed; training bots are not (a policy choice).

drivers.title: Popularity: Tranco rank #4,832; 28 Wikipedia article(s) link to it
drivers.detail: Tranco ranks the top 1M domains by aggregated traffic lists (2026-10-14). Linking articles include: Walnut Valley Unified School District, Diamond Bar, California, Walnut, California, Walnut High School.
drivers.copyNote: Brand demand and reference links build over years.

drivers.title: App Store demand: "NerdWallet: Smart Money App" rated 4.8 from 125,314 ratings
drivers.detail: Finance; Free; last update 2026-10-13. Store listings rank for brand and category searches and send users who never touch the website.
drivers.copyNote: Ratings accrue with users; prompt for reviews at the moment of value.

drivers.title: Topical breadth: 1,504 known URLs across 17 clusters of 10+ pages
drivers.detail: Largest clusters: /mortgages (175, review), /insurance (167, programmatic), /credit-cards (141, page), /business (134, review). Sitemap index lists 107 child sitemaps (us/posts-articles x61, ca/posts-flex-pages x9, us/posts-insurance-flex-pages x6).
drivers.copyNote: Years of publishing; copy the cluster shape, not the volume.

drivers.title: Commercial-intent pages: 28 review/comparison URLs in the mapped sample
drivers.copyNote: Needs honest product testing to be credible.

drivers.title: Long-form content: median 3,221 words across 6 fetched editorial pages
drivers.copyNote: Needs writers with subject knowledge; length alone does not rank.

drivers.title: Structured data on 93% of 30 sampled pages
drivers.detail: Types by page count: Organization 25, ImageObject 21, Person 21, WebSite 21, Country 20. Pages with JSON-LD errors: 0.
drivers.copyNote: A template change; no content needed.

drivers.title: Interactive tools: 7 calculator/tool URLs
drivers.copyNote: Needs engineering, then earns links and repeat visits.

drivers.title: Distribution beyond search: iOS App Store, Google Play, 6 social profiles, Newsletter
drivers.detail: iOS App Store (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nerdwallet-smart-money-app/id1174471607); Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mobilecreditcards&hl=en_US&source_caller=ui&shortlink=233a7a41&c=mbma_mktg_footer_badge_android&pid=footer); Social: x (https://x.com/NerdWallet); Social: youtube (https://www.youtube.com/@nerdwallet); Social: instagram (https://www.instagram.com/NerdWallet/); Social: tiktok (https://www.tiktok.com/@nerdwallet?lang=en); Social: linkedin (https://www.linkedin.com/company/nerdwallet); Social: facebook (https://www.facebook.com/NerdWallet/); Newsletter
drivers.copyNote: Each channel is a product or a habit, not a page.

weaknesses.title: Not in the checked results for 5/10 of its own head terms
weaknesses.detail: "capital one business" (#1 capitalone.com); "credit score" (#1 creditkarma.com); "financial advisors" (#1 yelp.com); "credit report" (#1 annualcreditreport.com); "credit union" (#1 lafcu.org)
weaknesses.opening: Publish a better page for "capital one business", "credit score", "financial advisors"; nerdwallet.com is not in the checked results.

weaknesses.title: Blocks AI training crawlers: Google-Extended
weaknesses.detail: Search-time bots are allowed; training bots are not (a policy choice).
weaknesses.opening: Models trained without the site know less about the brand.

weaknesses.title: No /llms.txt
weaknesses.opening: Publish your own /llms.txt; it has none that validates.

weaknesses.title: Heavy HTML: median 1160 KB per sampled page
weaknesses.detail: Raw HTML only (scripts and images not counted).
weaknesses.opening: Lighter pages crawl and render faster.

notes: Google (headless Chromium) blocked on "business credit cards" (Google captcha (unusual traffic page)); not asked again this run.
